Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+0.5 dB, sensitivity=22.2) and elevated β_l (+7.0 dB, sensitivity=3.6).
The δ activity is present in 7% of each epoch (transient), with moderate eye movements (Blink 38% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is conflicting with W physiology: missing: α elevated+relevant, EOG active. Note: model primarily uses δ, atypical for W.
